    Control entry and exit

    Manage authorised vehicles in both directions. PARKEZI Two-Way supports controlled access at gated communities, office complexes and other sites where entry and exit need to be managed.

    • Number plate recognition for authorised vehicles
    • Access rules for residents, staff and visitors
    • Control security gates, boom gates and garage doors
    • Live occupancy and vehicle counts
    • Cloud management and reporting

    Suitable sites: Office complexes, residential buildings and industrial sites.
